messages:
Olivia Chen: Quick heads-up — planning a production rollout for SDK 3.0 tomorrow at 10:00 PT (rolling, region-by-region). Window ~45m. Need: deploy owner, smoke checks list, rollback readiness, and client-comm plan. Will target canary us-west1 first.

Raj Patel: I can own the deploy. I’ll kick off the canary at 10:00 PT and stay on the thread. I’ll follow the standard rolling script and mark each region.

Ben Ortiz: QA will run smoke runs. My checklist: auth handshake, streaming responses, embeddings parity, and client-compat tests. I’ll run these scripts right after canary is green and post results here (+ screenshots/logs).

Sasha Ivanov: I’ll be on metrics and paging. Monitoring checklist: error rate, p50/p95 latency, and mem/gpu worker errors. Threshold for immediate rollback: >2% user-facing errors OR latency >2x SLO for >5 minutes. I’ll add short-lived alerts and an ops dashboard link. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: build #1982 passed, integration tests: 412/412 OK, canary-image pushed -> gcr.io/redwood/sdk:3.0-rc.1

Maria Gomez: Compatibility note: SDK 3.0 renames `session_id` -> `conversation_id`. We added a compatibility shim that accepts `session_id` for SDK 2.x clients for 30 days, but it logs a deprecation warning. Please include this in client comms. Example: 
```
# old
POST /v1/generate { "session_id": "abc", "prompt": "hi" }
# new
POST /v1/generate { "conversation_id": "abc", "prompt": "hi" }
```

Pete Liu: We should publish a short migration guide and a single-sentence change note in the dashboard banner and #customers. I can draft the email templates if Maria shares the exact wording. CTA: include code samples and a rollback timeline.

Olivia Chen: Go/no-go checklist (quick):
- Canary deploy complete and green in us-west1
- CI green (deploy-bot reported)
- QA smoke tests passed (Ben)
- No abnormal metrics for 10m after canary (Sasha)
- Migration note published to console + changelog (Pete/Maria)
If any of these fail, we rollback the canary and abort the roll. Raj, confirm you have `rollback.sh` ready and a dev who can run it.

Raj Patel: Confirmed — `rollback.sh` present and tested on staging. I’ll keep the runbook open and ping @oncall if anything looks off. Starting canary at 10:00 PT. :rocket:

Ben Ortiz: I’ll post the smoke script output here as soon as done. Quick note: streaming tests sometimes need a 3s wait for kv cache warmup — will account for that.

Sasha Ivanov: I’ll leave alerts unmuted and will escalate if error budget crosses threshold. Posting dashboard link right after canary: https://console.internal/redwood/dash/ops-sdk3

Maria Gomez: Draft for customer note ready; will drop in #marketing for review and then we can push to #customers. Includes migration snippet and timeline for the shim.

Olivia Chen: Perfect. Thanks everyone — we’ll reconvene here during the deploy. If you’re not actively needed, standby. :call_me_hand:
